Now I understand the fuzzer. It:
1. Creates an OpenThread instance
2. Becomes a leader
3. Sends an IPv6 message (data[0] controls link security, data[1:] is the IPv6 packet)
4. Processes tasklets for up to 100 iterations

The IPv6 packet needs to contain a CoAP message targeting the MGMT_ACTIVE_SET URI (`c/as`).
